name: hand out hyperplanes that meet only at the secret point
mechanism: place the secret as one coordinate of a point in a space whose dimension equals the threshold; give each holder a random hyperplane through that point; threshold-many hyperplanes intersect in exactly the point, fewer in a line or larger flat that leaves the secret open

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Blakey's scheme' in section Computer science / Cryptography:

fails_when: shares are larger than the secret; fewer than threshold shares still narrow the secret to a flat unless coordinates are chosen carefully
